# Environment variables

**For:** self-hosters setting up or tuning a server. **At the end:** you know every setting, which program reads it, its default and an example value.

<!-- Generated by tools/manual/generate.py from tools/manual/env.toml and a scan of the code. Edit the source, then run `uv run python tools/manual/generate.py`. tests/test_manual.py fails while this is stale. -->

Every program is one command of the same image: `wow-stats ui`, `publish`, `static`, `exporter`, `render`, `users`. The compose kit (`deploy/compose`) sets most of these for you: in `.env` you only set what its comments name. "Read by" says which command reads a variable; `compose` means only `docker compose` reads it, from `.env`.

A variable ending in `_FILE` names a file that holds the value (a secret, a key). Prefer it to the plain form: a file doesn't show up in `docker inspect` or a process list.

## The page (`wow-stats ui`)

The live full view, and the old live public view.

| Variable | Read by | Type | Default | Example | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ALLOWED_HOSTS` | ui | host names, comma separated | empty: localhost, IP addresses and the hosts of `PUBLIC_URL` and `MCP_PUBLIC_URL` only | `nas.local,wow-full.example.org` | More names the page answers for. Any other `Host` gets 421, so a web page can't read yours through your browser. A name here means a proxy or another computer in front, so the full view with `AUTH=open` refuses to start with it: set a login (`AUTH=basic` or `AUTH=proxy`). In the compose kit: `UI_ALLOWED_HOSTS` (and `PUBLIC_ALLOWED_HOSTS` for the public view). |
| `ALLOW_OPEN` | ui | `1` or empty | empty | `1` | Lets `AUTH=open` listen beyond loopback: everyone who reaches the port gets in. Only for a public view. In the compose kit: `PUBLIC_ALLOW_OPEN`. |
| `AUTH` | ui | `none`, `open`, `proxy` or `basic` | `none` on a loopback `BIND`, else required | `proxy` | The page's login. `none`: loopback only. `open`: no login, on purpose. `proxy`: a reverse proxy in front logs people in. `basic`: HTTP basic auth. |
| `BASIC_AUTH_PASSWORD` | ui | secret, 12+ characters | empty | a long random string | The password for `AUTH=basic`. Prefer `BASIC_AUTH_PASSWORD_FILE`. |
| `BASIC_AUTH_PASSWORD_FILE` | ui | path | empty | `/run/secrets/basic_password` | A file holding the `AUTH=basic` password. Wins over `BASIC_AUTH_PASSWORD`. |
| `BASIC_AUTH_USER` | ui | text | empty | `me` | The user name for `AUTH=basic`. |
| `BIND` | ui, static, render | address | `0.0.0.0` in the image, `127.0.0.1` outside it | `127.0.0.1` | The address the server listens on. |
| `CACHE_TTL` | ui, publish | seconds | `45` | `45` | How long an answer worked out when asked stays in memory. A plain open of the page gets the answers built in the background once per new data instead. |
| `DEFAULT_CHAR` | ui, publish | `Name-Surname` | empty: the character seen last | `Testchar-Demo` | The character the page and the MCP tools open on. |
| `FULL_DOOR_PATH` | ui | path | `/full/` | empty | The login door of the full view on a shared host: it answers with a redirect to `/`. Empty turns it off, for a full view on its own host. |
| `PORT` | ui, static, render | port | `8080` (`8083` for `render`) | `8080` | The port the server listens on. |
| `PRICE_DAYS` | ui, publish | days | `90` | `30` | Days of Auctionator scans in the prices panel. |
| `PROXY_SECRET_FILE` | ui | path | empty | `/run/secrets/proxy_secret` | With `AUTH=proxy`: a file holding a secret of 32 characters or more that the proxy sends in `PROXY_SECRET_HEADER` on every request. |
| `PROXY_SECRET_HEADER` | ui | header name | `X-Proxy-Auth` | `X-Proxy-Auth` | The header that carries `PROXY_SECRET_FILE`'s secret. |
| `PROXY_TRUSTED_CIDRS` | ui | addresses or CIDRs, comma separated | empty | `192.0.2.10/32` | With `AUTH=proxy`: the login proxy's addresses as this server sees them. Requests from elsewhere don't get their identity header read. This or `PROXY_SECRET_FILE` (or both) is required. |
| `PUBLISHED_ON` | ui | address:port | empty | `127.0.0.1:8080` | Where the container's port is published on the host. A loopback address lets `AUTH=open` run inside the container. The compose kit sets it from `UI_PUBLISH` and `PUBLIC_PUBLISH`. |
| `RENDER_FROM` | ui | URL | empty: no picture, the 3D toggle | `http://site:8080` | Where the full view gets a character's picture: the publisher's still of the 3D model, in the static site's bundles. Set it to the static site's address. |
| `VIEW` | ui | `full` or `public` | `full` on a loopback `BIND`, else required | `public` | Which view this process serves. One process serves one view, so a routing mistake can't hand the full view to an outsider. |
| `WEIGHTS` | ui, publish | comma list of `Name-Surname:spec` | empty: what the addons say | `Testchar-Demo:shadow` | The spec each character's gear is scored for. The page's own selector still wins. |
| `WOW_TIMEZONE` | ui, publish | IANA timezone | `Europe/Brussels` | `America/New_York` | The player's timezone, for the hours and weekdays the analysis reads. |

## Uploads from the shipper

`POST /ingest`, on the full view's port.

| Variable | Read by | Type | Default | Example | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `INGEST_DAILY_MB` | ui | megabytes | `512` | `1024` | On a shared install, how much each person may upload per UTC day. `0`: no limit. |
| `INGEST_PASSWORD` | ui, compose | secret, 12+ characters | empty: no `/ingest` | a long random string | Turns on `POST /ingest`, where the shipper sends events, with this password. Required by the compose kit. |
| `INGEST_PASSWORD_FILE` | ui | path | empty | `/run/secrets/ingest_password` | A file holding the ingest password. Wins over `INGEST_PASSWORD`. |
| `INGEST_USER` | ui | text | `wow` | `wow` | The user name the shipper sends with the ingest password. |

## The stores

Where the events and the Battle.net data live.

| Variable | Read by | Type | Default | Example | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `LOGS_FILTER` | ui, publish | LogsQL filter | `feed:wow-*` | `feed:wow-* site:home` | Selects the game events in VictoriaLogs. Add your own labels here. |
| `VL_ACCOUNT_ID` | ui, publish | whole number | `0` | `0` | The VictoriaLogs tenant to read. Set per person by a shared install; leave it alone otherwise. |
| `VL_ARCHIVE_AFTER_DAYS` | ui, publish | days | `89` | `89` | With `VL_ARCHIVE_URL`: days older than this are read from the archive. |
| `VL_ARCHIVE_URL` | ui, publish | URL | empty: one store holds everything | `http://vl-archive:9428` | A second VictoriaLogs for days older than `VL_ARCHIVE_AFTER_DAYS`. |
| `VL_CONCURRENCY` | ui, publish | number | `2` | `2` | VictoriaLogs requests this process runs at once, all callers together. |
| `VL_URL` | ui, publish | URL | `http://victorialogs:9428` | `http://victorialogs:9428` | The VictoriaLogs that holds the game events. Keep it private: only `ui` and `publish` talk to it. |
| `VM_URL` | ui, publish, compose | URL | empty: no Battle.net data | `http://victoriametrics:8428` | The VictoriaMetrics the exporter pushes to. The public view reads only the character profile from it, never market data. |

## Game data and the 3D view

What the servers download, and the bundled reference data.

| Variable | Read by | Type | Default | Example | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `GEAR_REFERENCE_FILE` | ui, publish | path or `off` | the bundled Polestar gear data | `off` | Another gear data file, or `off` to turn gear advice off. |
| `ITEM_FACTS_DIR` | ui, publish, compose | path | `<MODEL3D_CACHE_DIR>/item-facts` | `/data/item-facts` | Where the item facts each person's shipper reads from their game's hotfix cache are kept (items the reference doesn't have yet). With several people, each one's are in their own folder (`users/<id>/items`) and go when the person is removed; this setting is then ignored. The publisher reads the ui's folder (read-only). |
| `KB_GAME_TABLES` | ui, publish | `on` or `off` | `on` | `off` | The knowledge base's spell and zone documents from Forever's tables. |
| `MODEL3D` | ui, publish, compose | `on` or `off` | `on` | `off` | The "View in 3D" toggle: the character drawn from the game files your shipper sends (nothing downloaded). `off` removes it, and the shipper stops sending them. |
| `MODEL3D_ASSETS_DIR` | ui, publish, compose | path | `<MODEL3D_CACHE_DIR>/assets` | `/data/model3d-assets` | Where the game files the shipper sends for the 3D view are kept. With several people, each one's are in their own folder (`users/<id>/assets`) and go when the person is removed; this setting is then ignored. The publisher reads the ui's folder (read-only) to bundle each character's files. |
| `MODEL3D_ASSETS_MB` | ui | MiB | `512` | `1024` | The most disk one person's 3D files may take; past it an upload gets a 507 and the shipper stops sending. |
| `MODEL3D_CACHE_DIR` | ui, publish | path | a folder under the temp dir | `/data/model3d-cache` | Where downloaded game tables and icons are kept, and the 3D answers. Put it on a volume so a restart doesn't download them again. |
| `MODEL3D_MODELS` | ui, publish | `hd` or `sd` | `hd` | `sd` | The models the 3D view opens on: `hd` the updated ones, `sd` the original (Classic) ones. A visitor's own pick in the view wins. With several people, each one's Settings choice replaces it. |
| `ROUTE_REFERENCE_FILE` | ui, publish | path or `off` | the bundled Polestar route times | `off` | Another route times file, or `off` to compare levels with your own past levels only. |
| `WOW_ITEMS` | ui, publish, compose | `on` or `off` | `on` | `off` | Item names, icons and tooltip cards from Forever's tables on wago.tools. `off` with `MODEL3D=off` is the small preset: no downloads at all. |
| `WOW_TALENTS` | ui, publish | `on` or `off` | `on` (`off` when `WOW_ITEMS=off`) | `off` | Talent names and icons from Forever's tables. |

## The MCP endpoint and its login

For your AI assistant. Off until `MCP_PUBLIC_URL` is set. [Connect your AI](../ai/connect.md) and [Set up a login](../self-host/oidc.md) use them.

| Variable | Read by | Type | Default | Example | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `MCP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS` | ui | comma list of origins | empty | `https://inspector.example.org` | Extra browser origins allowed to call `/mcp`. |
| `MCP_AUTH` | ui | `oauth` or `none` | `oauth` | `none` | `none` (no login) only works on a loopback `BIND`. |
| `MCP_CIMD_HOSTS` | ui | comma list of hosts | Claude, ChatGPT/Codex, opencode, VS Code, Copilot CLI, Zed, Goose | `claude.ai` | Replaces the list of hosts whose client documents (a URL as client id) are fetched. |
| `MCP_LOGIN` | ui | `oidc` | `oidc` | `oidc` | The only value. The old `password` login is gone: the server refuses to start with it. |
| `MCP_PORT` | ui | port | `8090` | `8090` | The MCP endpoint's own port, on `BIND`. `/mcp` and the login paths are served there, never on `PORT`. |
| `MCP_PUBLIC_URL` | ui, publish, compose | https URL ending in `/mcp` | empty: no MCP endpoint | `https://wow.example.org/mcp` | Turns on the MCP endpoint (full view only) and names the address clients use. The help page shows it too. |
| `MCP_REDIRECT_URIS` | ui | comma list of URLs | the web callbacks of claude.ai, ChatGPT, VS Code and Cursor, plus loopback | `https://claude.ai/api/mcp/auth_callback` | Replaces the list of redirects a registering client may use. |
| `MCP_SIGNING_KEY_FILE` | ui, compose | path, 32+ random bytes | empty: a random key per start | `/run/wow-secrets/mcp_signing_key` | Signs the MCP tokens and encrypts the stored logins. Without it, every restart logs every client out. |
| `MCP_STATE_DIR` | ui | path | empty: memory only | `/data/mcp` | Keeps client registrations and logins (encrypted) across restarts. |
| `OIDC_ALLOWED_ORGS` | ui | comma list | empty | `28437001` | One-person install: the organisation ids allowed, read from `OIDC_ORG_CLAIM`. |
| `OIDC_ALLOWED_SUBS` | ui, compose | comma list | empty | `3f2c9a10-...` | The account ids (`sub` claim) allowed in. Required on a one-person install. |
| `OIDC_BATTLENET_IDP_ID` | ui | ZITADEL identity provider id (digits) | empty: no Battle.net button | `28437002` | ZITADEL only, with `OIDC_BATTLENET_ORG_ID`: the Battle.net identity provider that button starts at once. A new account lands in that org. |
| `OIDC_BATTLENET_ORG_ID` | ui | ZITADEL org id (digits) | empty: no Battle.net button | `28437001` | ZITADEL only, with `OIDC_BATTLENET_IDP_ID`: the org a "Sign in with Battle.net" button on the MCP consent page asks for. Both or neither. |
| `OIDC_CLIENT_ID` | ui, compose | text | empty | `wow-mcp` | The app's client id at your identity provider. |
| `OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET` | ui | secret | empty | use the `_FILE` form | The client secret itself, when `OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET_FILE` isn't set. Prefer the file. |
| `OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET_FILE` | ui, compose | path | `/run/wow-secrets/oidc_client_secret` in the compose kit | `/run/wow-secrets/oidc_client_secret` | A file holding the app's client secret. |
| `OIDC_ISSUER` | ui, compose | https URL | empty | `https://id.example.org/realms/wow` | Your identity provider (its discovery document lives under this address). Required with `MCP_PUBLIC_URL`. |
| `OIDC_ORG_CLAIM` | ui | claim name | ZITADEL's org id claim | `org_id` | The claim that holds the organisation id. Set your provider's. |
| `OIDC_REQUIRED_ROLE` | ui | text | empty | `wow` | One-person install: a role the account must have, read from `OIDC_ROLES_CLAIM`. Removing it ends the login at the next refresh. |
| `OIDC_ROLES_CLAIM` | ui | claim name | ZITADEL's project roles claim | `roles` | The claim that holds the roles. Set your provider's. |
| `OIDC_SCOPES` | ui | space-separated scopes | `openid offline_access` (plus the org scope with `OIDC_ALLOWED_ORGS`) | `openid offline_access` | What the app asks the provider for. |

## The play analysis and plans

Kept per character, judged by the server.

| Variable | Read by | Type | Default | Example | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ANALYSIS_API_KEY_FILE` | ui | path | empty: none | `/run/secrets/analysis-key` | A file holding the AI provider's API key, read at the first run, never logged. Used when workload identity federation isn't set up; a local `openai` endpoint may need none. `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` and `OPENAI_API_KEY` are never read. |
| `ANALYSIS_AUTO` | ui | `on` or `off` | `on` | `off` | Whether the page rebuild starts the server's own analysis after `ANALYSIS_STALE_PLAYED_HOURS` of play. Off: only a player's `dashboard_refresh` does. |
| `ANALYSIS_BASE_URL` | ui | URL | empty: the provider's own API | `http://ollama:11434/v1` | The API's address: an OpenAI-compatible endpoint with `ANALYSIS_PROVIDER=openai`, or a proxy in front of Anthropic's. `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` and `OPENAI_BASE_URL` are never read. |
| `ANALYSIS_HOUR` | ui | hour, 0 to 23 | `4` | `4` | The local hour of the nightly recheck of kept findings. |
| `ANALYSIS_MODEL` | ui | model id | `claude-opus-5-5` with `anthropic`; required with `openai` | `claude-sonnet-5-5` | The model the server's own analysis runs on. It must support tool calling. |
| `ANALYSIS_MONTHLY_BUDGET` | ui | US dollars | `10` | `50` | What the server's own analysis may spend a calendar month (UTC), in USD, the currency the APIs bill in. A run that would likely cross it doesn't start. With `openai`, only when both prices below are set. |
| `ANALYSIS_MONTHLY_TOKENS` | ui | tokens | empty: no cap | `20000000` | A cap in tokens (sent and received) a month, besides or instead of the money one: the cap for an endpoint with no prices. |
| `ANALYSIS_PRICE_CACHED_INPUT_PER_MTOK` | ui | US dollars | empty: the input price | `0.015` | With `openai`: what the endpoint charges per million cached prompt tokens (OpenAI: a tenth of the input price or less). Most of a run's prompt is cached, so without it the count runs several times over the bill. |
| `ANALYSIS_PRICE_INPUT_PER_MTOK` | ui | US dollars | empty: cost unknown | `0.15` | With `openai`: what the endpoint charges per million prompt tokens. Set it and the next one to count money and apply the budget; Anthropic's prices are built in. |
| `ANALYSIS_PRICE_OUTPUT_PER_MTOK` | ui | US dollars | empty: cost unknown | `0.60` | With `openai`: what the endpoint charges per million completion tokens. |
| `ANALYSIS_PROVIDER` | ui | `anthropic` or `openai` | `anthropic` | `openai` | Who runs the server's own play analysis: Anthropic's API, or any OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions endpoint (OpenAI, OpenRouter, Ollama, vLLM, LM Studio). Off until it has credentials, or for `openai` a model. See [Server-side analysis](../self-host/server-analysis.md). |
| `ANALYSIS_SHARE_BIND` | ui | address | `BIND`, else `127.0.0.1` | `0.0.0.0` | The address the share port listens on. |
| `ANALYSIS_SHARE_PORT` | ui | port | empty: off | `8091` | A bare listener that hands the screened analysis lines to the publisher. Never route it from outside. |
| `ANALYSIS_SHARE_TOKEN_FILE` | ui, publish, exporter | path | empty: `share-token` in the state folder, made on first start | `/data/share-token` | The share port's bearer token. `ui` makes it on first start; `publish` and the exporter read the same file to call the share port. |
| `ANALYSIS_SHARE_URL` | publish | URL | empty: none | `http://ui:8091/analysis.json` | Where the publisher reads those lines, for `/zogzog/`. |
| `ANALYSIS_STALE_PLAYED_HOURS` | ui | hours of play | `10` | `6` | How much in-game play since a player's last analysis makes the server refresh it (the journal's sessions, every character). Any refresh resets it: the server's, the player's `dashboard_refresh`, or a full analysis from their own AI. |
| `ANALYSIS_STATE_DIR` | ui | path | empty: off | `/data/analysis` | Where the play analysis and the session plans are kept (full view only). Put it on a volume. |
| `ANALYSIS_WIF_AUDIENCE` | ui | string | `https://api.anthropic.com` with `anthropic`, `https://api.openai.com/v1` with `openai` | `https://api.openai.com/v1` | The audience the projected token must carry, checked before each client is made so a wrong volume says so instead of an opaque 401. Set it only when the provider was configured with another audience. |
| `ANALYSIS_WIF_ORGANIZATION_ID` | ui | id | empty: none | an organization UUID | With `anthropic`: your organization. |
| `ANALYSIS_WIF_PROVIDER_ID` | ui | id | empty: none | the Workload Identity Provider's id | With `openai`: the Workload Identity Provider (Organization settings, Security). |
| `ANALYSIS_WIF_RULE_ID` | ui | id | empty: none | `fdrl_...` | With `anthropic`: the federation rule. |
| `ANALYSIS_WIF_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_ID` | ui | id | empty: none | `svac_...` | The service account the token is exchanged for: required with `openai`, optional with `anthropic`. |
| `ANALYSIS_WIF_TOKEN_FILE` | ui | path | empty: no federation | `/var/run/secrets/ai-token/token` | Workload identity federation, either provider: the identity token's file (a Kubernetes projected service account token), reread at each exchange as it rotates. With the provider's IDs below it comes before `ANALYSIS_API_KEY_FILE`. See [Server-side analysis](../self-host/server-analysis.md). |
| `ANALYSIS_WIF_WORKSPACE_ID` | ui | id | empty: none | `wrkspc_...` | With `anthropic`, optional: the workspace the exchanged token works in. |

## The static sites (`wow-stats publish`, `wow-stats static`)

The public site and the sealed `/zogzog/` site. [Share your page](../self-host/sharing.md).

| Variable | Read by | Type | Default | Example | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `HELP_KEY_FILE` | publish | path | empty: no help page | `/data/help.key` | The friends' help page key (`/help/#<key>`), 43 base64url characters. Never made for you: no file, no page. |
| `HELP_MCP_URL` | publish | URL | `MCP_PUBLIC_URL` | `https://wow.example.org/mcp` | The MCP address the help page shows. |
| `PLAUSIBLE_API` | publish, ui | path | `/api/event` | `/api/event` | The event path on the site's own address. Route it to your Plausible. |
| `PLAUSIBLE_DOMAIN` | publish, ui, compose | domain | empty: no analytics | `wow.example.org` | Your Plausible site: one pageview per page on the static sites and the full view, through your own address, without the `/zogzog/` key. The same value on the publisher and the ui: one Plausible site for every host. |
| `PLAUSIBLE_SCRIPT` | publish, ui | path | `/js/script.js` | `/js/script.js` | The script path on the site's own address. Route it to your Plausible. |
| `PUBLISH_DIR` | publish | path | `/data/site` | `/data/site` | Where builds go; `current` points at the live one. |
| `PUBLISH_INTERVAL` | publish, compose | seconds | `600` | `600` | With `--loop`: how often to check for new events. |
| `PUBLISH_PUSH_TOKEN_FILE` | publish | path | empty | `/run/secrets/upload_token` | The push token, 32+ characters. Same value as the static server's `UPLOAD_TOKEN_FILE`. |
| `PUBLISH_PUSH_URL` | publish | URL | empty: share a volume | `http://site-upload:8099` | Push each build to a static server's upload port instead of sharing a volume. |
| `SITE_DIR` | static | path | `/data/site` | `/data/site` | What the static server serves: the publisher's `PUBLISH_DIR`. |
| `UPLOAD_PORT` | static | port | `0`: off | `8099` | The push listener. Never route it from outside. |
| `UPLOAD_TOKEN_FILE` | static | path | empty | `/run/secrets/upload_token` | The token a push must carry, 32+ characters. |
| `ZOGZOG_KEY_FILE` | publish, ui | path | `zogzog.key` next to `PUBLISH_DIR` | `/data/zogzog.key` | The sealed site's key, 43 base64url characters. Made (mode 0600) when missing. |
| `ZOGZOG_LINK_BASE` | publish | URL | empty | `https://wow.example.org` | The site's address, for the link `zogzog-key link` prints. |
| `ZOGZOG_PATH` | ui, publish, static, compose | path | `/zogzog/` | empty | The sealed site's path. Set and empty: no sealed site is built or served. |

## Past levels' pictures (`wow-stats render`)

Optional. A separate image with Chromium.

| Variable | Read by | Type | Default | Example | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `RENDER_BUDGET_S` | publish | seconds | `60` | `60` | How long a build spends drawing. The rest wait for the next pass. |
| `RENDER_CACHE_DIR` | render | path | a folder under `/tmp` | `/tmp/render-cache` | Where the renderer keeps the game files the publisher sent it (by file id, no names) and its token. |
| `RENDER_CACHE_MB` | render | MiB | `256` | `256` | The most disk those files may take; the least recently used go first. |
| `RENDER_TIMEOUT_S` | publish, render | seconds | `120` in `publish`, `90` in `render` | `120` | The longest one picture may take. |
| `RENDER_URL` | publish | URL | empty: no pictures | `http://render:8083` | The renderer that draws each past level's picture. |

## Several people on one install

Off until `WOW_STATE_DIR` is set. [Add friends](../self-host/friends.md).

| Variable | Read by | Type | Default | Example | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `DOH_URL` | ui | URL | empty | `https://cloudflare-dns.com/dns-query` | A DNS-over-HTTPS resolver, to tell whether a friend's host resolves yet. |
| `FRIENDS_RECONCILE_S` | ui | seconds | `120` | `120` | How often the friends list gets a full pass anyway (a change to the file applies sooner, within about 10 seconds); it retries what failed. |
| `FRIENDS_VL_DELETE_KEY_FILE` | ui, users | path | empty | `/run/secrets/vl_delete_key` | That VictoriaLogs' `-deleteAuthKey`, so a friend's events can be deleted. |
| `FRIENDS_VL_URL` | ui, publish, users | URL | empty: no friends | `http://vl-friends:9428` | The friends' VictoriaLogs, one tenant each. |
| `ITEM_FACTS_URL` | publish | URL | set per person from `USERS_URL` | `http://ui:8091/items/sam/` | Where the publisher reads one person's item facts: the full view's share port. Set by the publisher itself with several people; leave it unset. |
| `MODEL3D_ASSETS_URL` | publish | URL | set per person from `USERS_URL` | `http://ui:8091/assets/sam/` | Where the publisher reads one person's 3D files: the full view's share port. Set by the publisher itself with several people; leave it unset. |
| `PRIVACY_BACKUP_DAYS` | ui | days | empty: the privacy page says to ask the owner | `30` | How long your backups keep events, as the privacy page tells your friends. |
| `PRIVACY_LOG_DAYS` | ui | days | empty: the privacy page says to ask the owner | `30` | How long the server's logs keep a request (the web server's access log and the app's own log), as the privacy page tells your friends. |
| `PROFILE_CHARACTERS_URL` | exporter | URL | empty | `http://ui:8091/profile-characters` | Adds every person's characters to `PROFILE_CHARACTERS`, each under its own account: at most 12 a day per friend. |
| `PROXY_BATTLETAG_HEADER` | ui | header name | empty: names come from the friends list only | `X-Forwarded-BattleTag` | The header your login proxy puts the BattleTag in (ZITADEL with a Battle.net login: the `name` claim). A listed friend with no name in the list gets one from it at their first login: the BattleTag's name, a hyphen and a keyed hash (`petrel-3f9a`), never the `#1234`. Read at that moment only, never kept. The proxy must replace any copy the client sent. |
| `PROXY_USER_HEADER` | ui | header name | `X-Forwarded-User` | `X-Forwarded-User` | The header your login proxy puts the account id in. The proxy must strip any copy the client sent. |
| `PUBLIC_URL` | ui | URL | empty | `https://wow-full.example.org` | The full view's address, for install commands and the MCP. |
| `PUBLISH_REPORT_URL` | publish | URL | `USERS_URL`'s folder, `/publisher.json` | `http://ui:8091/publisher.json` | Where the publisher reports each pass, for the owner's overview (`/admin`). |
| `SITE_ALIASES` | static | comma list of `host=slug` | empty | `wow.example.org=alex` | Extra hosts and whose site each one serves. |
| `SITE_DOMAIN` | ui, static | domain | empty | `example.org` | Friends' sites live at `<slug>-wow.<domain>`. |
| `USERS_URL` | publish, ui | URL | empty: one site | `http://ui:8091/users.json` | The full view's share port: build one site per person. On the live public view (`VIEW=public`, the `ui-public` service), with `ANALYSIS_SHARE_TOKEN_FILE`: follow the owner's Settings (public page off answers 404, hidden characters aren't there; read every 30 s, and off until the first answer). Without it that view shows every character. |
| `WOW_FRIENDS_FILE` | ui, users | path to JSON `{"<sub>": "<slug>"}`, `{"<sub>": ""}` or `["<sub>"]` | empty: the owner only | `/run/wow/friends.json` | Who gets in besides the owner. Watched while the server runs: a change applies within about 10 seconds, without a restart (mount its folder, not the file alone). A person who leaves the list is offboarded at once. An empty slug (or a plain list of subs) leaves the name to `PROXY_BATTLETAG_HEADER`. |
| `WOW_OWNER_ALIASES` | ui, users | comma list of hosts | empty | `wow.example.org` | Hosts that belong to the owner too. |
| `WOW_OWNER_SLUG` | ui, users | 2 to 24 of a-z, 0-9, one inner hyphen at most | `sam`: set your own | `alex` | The owner's site name. Refusal pages name the owner by it. |
| `WOW_OWNER_SUB` | ui, users | text | empty | `3f2c9a10-...` | The owner's account id at the identity provider. |
| `WOW_STATE_DIR` | ui, users | path | empty: one person | `/data/people` | Turns on several people per install: the registry and each person's state live here. |
| `ZOGZOG_MASTER_KEY_FILE` | ui, publish, users | path, 32+ random bytes, base64url | empty | `/run/secrets/zogzog_master` | Each person's sealed-site key is derived from it, so the full view and the publisher agree without sharing a file. |

## The Battle.net exporter (`wow-stats exporter`)

Optional. Needs your own API client. [Battle.net data](../self-host/battlenet.md).

| Variable | Read by | Type | Default | Example | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `BNET_CLIENT_ID_FILE` | exporter | path | required | `/run/secrets/bnet_client_id` | A file holding **your own** Battle.net API client id. |
| `BNET_CLIENT_SECRET_FILE` | exporter | path | required | `/run/secrets/bnet_client_secret` | A file holding that client's secret. |
| `BNET_FOREVER_NAMESPACE` | exporter | text | `dynamic-forever-<region>` | `dynamic-forever-eu` | The API namespace for Forever's ruleset status. |
| `BNET_LOCALE` | exporter | locale | `en_GB` | `en_US` | The language of names in the API's answers. |
| `BNET_PROFILE_NAMESPACE` | exporter | text | `profile-forever-<region>` | `profile-forever-eu` | The namespace for character profiles. |
| `BNET_REGION` | exporter, compose | `eu`, `us`, `kr` or `tw` | `eu` | `us` | Your Battle.net region. |
| `BNET_TOKEN_NAMESPACES` | exporter | comma list | derived from the region | `dynamic-eu` | The namespaces read for the WoW Token price. |
| `HTTP_TIMEOUT` | exporter | seconds | `60` | `60` | Timeout of one API call. |
| `LISTEN_PORT` | exporter | port | `9464` | `9464` | The exporter's own port: `/healthz` and its own health metrics on `/metrics`, never Blizzard's data. |
| `PROFILE_CHARACTERS` | exporter, compose | comma list of `Name-Surname` | empty | `Testchar-Demo,Testalt-Demo` | Your characters, as their WTF folders name them: their look, level, gear and talents are read every 2 hours. |
| `PROFILE_INTERVAL` | exporter | seconds | `7200` | `7200` | Seconds between profile reads, on the clock (7200: 00:00, 02:00... UTC, whenever the exporter started). A character the list names for the first time is read within 5 minutes anyway, once. |
| `REALM_INTERVAL` | exporter | seconds | `300` | `300` | Seconds between ruleset status reads. |
| `TOKEN_INTERVAL` | exporter | seconds | `1200` | `1200` | Seconds between WoW Token reads. |
| `VM_MERGE_INTERVAL` | exporter | seconds | `86400` | `86400` | Seconds between force-merges. |
| `VM_MERGE_KEY_FILE` | exporter | path | empty | `/run/secrets/vm_merge_key` | VictoriaMetrics' `-forceMergeAuthKey`. With it the exporter force-merges daily, so expired data is really deleted. |
| `VM_MERGE_URL` | exporter | URL | `VM_PUSH_URL`'s host + `/internal/force_merge` | `http://victoriametrics:8428/internal/force_merge` | Where the force-merge goes. |
| `VM_PUSH_EXTRA_LABELS` | exporter | comma list of `name=value` | empty | `site=home` | Labels added to every pushed series. |
| `VM_PUSH_INTERVAL` | exporter | seconds | `60` | `60` | Seconds between pushes. |
| `VM_PUSH_URL` | exporter | URL | empty: nothing stored | `http://victoriametrics:8428/api/v1/import/prometheus` | Where the exporter pushes. Must be a VictoriaMetrics with a retention under 30 days. |

## The player's computer

Read by the shipper and its installers, not by the server.

| Variable | Read by | Type | Default | Example | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `WOW_STATS_CONFIG` | shipper | path | `~/.config/wow-stats/config.toml` (Mac), `%APPDATA%\wow-stats\config.toml` (Windows) | `~/wow-stats.toml` | Another config file for the shipper and its installers. |
| `WOW_STATS_NO_LOAD` | shipper, installer | `1` | empty | `1` | Install without starting the background job. For tests and trying the installer. |
| `WOW_STATS_QUIET` | installer | `1` | empty | `1` | The installers print less. Set by the install command itself. |
| `WOW_STATS_WOW_DIR` | installer | path | found by itself in the usual places | `D:\Games\World of Warcraft\_forever_` | The `_forever_` folder, when WoW is somewhere unusual. For the install command from the start page. |

## The compose kit's `.env` only

Read by `docker compose` in `deploy/compose`, not by a program. The other compose settings are the variables above, passed through.

| Variable | Read by | Type | Default | Example | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ACME_EMAIL` | compose | email address | required by `compose.traefik.yaml` | `you@example.org` | Where Let's Encrypt writes before a certificate expires (Traefik). |
| `MCP_PUBLISH` | compose | `address:port` | `127.0.0.1:8090` | `127.0.0.1:8090` | Where the MCP port is published on the host. |
| `PUBLIC_ALLOWED_HOSTS` | compose | host names, comma separated | empty | `wow.example.org` | `ALLOWED_HOSTS` for the `ui-public` service. |
| `PUBLIC_ALLOW_OPEN` | compose | `1` or empty | empty | `1` | `ALLOW_OPEN` for the `ui-public` service, when you publish it beyond `127.0.0.1`. |
| `PUBLIC_PUBLISH` | compose | `address:port` | `127.0.0.1:8082` | `127.0.0.1:8082` | The optional live public view (profile `public`). |
| `SITE_PUBLISH` | compose | `address:port` | `127.0.0.1:8081` | `127.0.0.1:8081` | Where the static sites are published on the host. |
| `SITE_URL` | compose | URL | `http://127.0.0.1:8081` | `https://wow.example.org` | The static sites' address, for the printed `/zogzog/` link (`ZOGZOG_LINK_BASE`). |
| `UI_ALLOWED_HOSTS` | compose | host names, comma separated | empty | `nas.local` | `ALLOWED_HOSTS` for the `ui` service. |
| `UI_AUTH` | compose | as `AUTH` | `open` | `basic` | The full view's `AUTH`. `open` is fine while the port stays on 127.0.0.1. |
| `UI_MEM_LIMIT` | compose | size | `1g` | `2g` | The memory limit of `ui`. |
| `UI_PUBLISH` | compose | `address:port` | `127.0.0.1:8080` | `0.0.0.0:8080` | Where the full view is published on the host. Leave it on 127.0.0.1 unless a login is set. |
| `VL_MAX_DISK` | compose | size | `0`: no ceiling | `20GiB` | A disk ceiling for the game events. Past it VictoriaLogs deletes the oldest days, for good. |
| `WOW_FULL_HOST` | compose | host name | required by the proxy files | `wow-full.example.org` | Your full view's and the MCP's host, for the proxy files. They also put it in `ALLOWED_HOSTS`. |
| `WOW_SITE_HOST` | compose | host name | required by the proxy files | `wow.example.org` | The static sites' host, for `compose.caddy.yaml`, `compose.traefik.yaml` or `compose.nginx.yaml`. Point its DNS at the server. |
| `WOW_STATS_IMAGE` | compose | image reference | `wow-stats:local`, built from the tree | `ghcr.io/<owner>/wow-mcp:0.5.0@sha256:...` | Run a released image instead of building the tree. |

## Tests and development

Point an upstream at a local server. Leave them alone in production.

| Variable | Read by | Type | Default | Example | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `BNET_API_URL` | exporter | URL | `https://<region>.api.blizzard.com` | `http://127.0.0.1:9002` | Blizzard's API. Tests point it at a local server. |
| `BNET_OAUTH_URL` | exporter | URL | `https://oauth.battle.net/token` | `http://127.0.0.1:9002/token` | Blizzard's token endpoint. Tests point it at a local server. |
| `ICON_URL` | ui, publish | URL | `https://wow.zamimg.com/images/wow/icons/` | `http://127.0.0.1:9000/icons/` | Where item icons are fetched. Tests point it at a local server. |
| `MODEL3D_PRODUCT` | ui, publish | text | `wowf` | `wowf` | The game build family read on wago.tools. |
| `MODEL3D_WAGO_URL` | ui, publish | URL | `https://wago.tools` | `http://127.0.0.1:9001` | Forever's game tables. Tests point it at a local server. |
| `NO_REAL_WOW` | shipper | flag | unset | `1` | Tests and agents: the shipper only takes a WoW folder under a temp directory, never the real install (the test suite sets it). |
| `STATIC_DIR` | ui | path | the packaged `web/` | `./web` | Serve the page's files from another folder. For working on the page. |
| `WOW_STATS_RECORDER_SHA256` | shipper | hex | the pinned release's | `e3b0c442...` | The checksum that zip must have. |
| `WOW_STATS_RECORDER_URL` | shipper | URL | the pinned Polestar Recorder release | `file:///tmp/Polestar_Recorder.zip` | Where the installer gets Polestar Recorder. Tests only; pair it with `WOW_STATS_RECORDER_SHA256`. |
